variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config
# First boot of the on-premises VM: Docker with the Compose plugin, and a helper that signs
# Docker in to the container registry with the VM's managed identity. Nothing here starts a
# service; the Compose file for ledger, account, audit, batch and the two databases is copied
# to /opt/coobs and started afterwards.
package_update: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - docker-compose-v2
  - curl
  - jq

write_files:
  - path: /usr/local/bin/acr-login
    permissions: '0755'
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      # Usage: acr-login <registry login server>
      # Exchanges the VM identity's token for a registry token (the identity holds AcrPull),
      # so no registry password is stored on the VM.
      set -eu
      REGISTRY="$1"
      TOKEN=$(curl -fsS -H Metadata:true "http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https%3A%2F%2Fmanagement.azure.com%2F" | jq -r .access_token)
      REFRESH=$(curl -fsS -X POST --data-urlencode "grant_type=access_token" --data-urlencode "service=$REGISTRY" --data-urlencode "access_token=$TOKEN" "https://$REGISTRY/oauth2/exchange" | jq -r .refresh_token)
      echo "$REFRESH" | docker login "$REGISTRY" --username 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --password-stdin

runcmd:
  - systemctl enable --now docker
  - usermod -aG docker __ADMIN_USER__
  - install -d -m 0750 -o __ADMIN_USER__ -g docker /opt/coobs
